messages:
noah: Heads-up: ran into a CI failure after key rotation. The sample-runner started failing with 401s only in one repo.

anya: Which repo? quickstart or infra-templates?

noah: infra-templates. Repro: CI has both RW_ORG_KEY and REDWOOD_API_KEY set. We rotate REDWOOD_API_KEY nightly, but the runner keeps using RW_ORG_KEY (old).

leo: Huh. I thought our SDK uses REDWOOD_API_KEY first, then org/project fallbacks. Did infra-templates vendor an old SDK?

noah: Bingo. They pinned @redwood/sdk-js v0.4.0 which had the opposite precedence: 
```js
// v0.4.0 (pinned in infra-templates)
const key = process.env.RW_ORG_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.RW_PROJECT_KEY;
```

noah: v0.6.x flips it to prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY, but infra-templates didn't float deps.

priya: This is messy for rotation because ops rotate REDWOOD_API_KEY but leave org key for backwards compat in some repos. CI secrets end up with two keys and rotation feels non-atomic.

ci-bot: CI job #4512 failed: http://ci.internal/4512 — 401 unauthorized (token mismatched)

anya: Short-term mitigation idea: update our rotate-key helper to optionally rotate all recognized env names (REDWOOD_API_KEY, RW_ORG_KEY, RW_PROJECT_KEY) when running in sample apps or infra templates. That makes rotation idempotent across pinned SDKs.

leo: Agreed. Also propose we publish a compat shim in the SDK that logs a single-line deprecation warning when older env names are present and include a link to a migration doc.

priya: We should add an explicit section to onboarding/docs: "CI secret hygiene" — recommend storing only REDWOOD_API_KEY, single source of truth, and show how to rotate safely. Include snippet for GH Actions and GitLab.

noah: Can we also add an integration test in infra-templates that runs rotate-key and then restarts the runner to ensure new key is picked up? Would catch pinned-sdk regressions.

leo: Yes — add an e2e to proto-ci image. I'll open a PR for infra-templates to bump the sdk to >=0.6.x and add the e2e.

anya: Longer term: SDK parity RFC — define canonical precedence and publish it. We need all language SDKs to agree (js, py, go). If a runtime changes precedence, that's a breaking behavioral change for rotation workflows.

priya: Also flagging runtime edgecase: streaming connections that authorize at handshake vs per-chunk. If key rotates mid-stream, some clients re-auth without reconnecting and some reconnect — inconsistent. We should document recommended server behavior: fail closed on invalid token and provide reconnection guidance.

ci-bot: Created issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/501, https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-templates/issues/88

noah: Plan: 1) emergency rotate-helper patch to write all env keys in infra templates (merge today), 2) infra-templates PR to bump SDK + e2e, 3) SDK PR to surface deprecation warning and link docs, 4) RFC for parity across SDKs + runtime note for streaming keys.

leo: I'll take infra-templates PR. priya — can you draft the onboarding secret hygiene blurb?

priya: On it, will ping for review in ~2 hrs.

anya: Thanks team. Good catch, noah. This would've been painful in a customer incident. :eyes:
